<p>The Tide is working for <em>perfection!</em> Pretty amazing how far this team has come from the start of the season. It’s so much fun! Every week the Tide is getting “bettah and bettah” to quote Coach Gene Stallings’ comments about his play makers of the week back in the day on the <em>Coach Stallings Show</em>. </p><p>&nbsp;Sounds just like jimbo’s coaching job at a&amp;m…bahahahaha…if it is Opposite Day maybe. Don’t forget at 69 games Coach Sumlin was at 47-22 for a&amp;m and was fired. jimbo has snuck by hanging on to his dismal record of 44-25. Y’all gonna need that collection plate going around sooner than later for that $76M pay out, aggies.</p><p>&nbsp;So this weekend there are <em>10</em> football games scheduled for 11 am (just like last weekend?!) and Alabama is one of them, <em>and</em> the football gods had the AUdacity to JP us (former despised 11ish am Jefferson Pilot channel kick-off time) again for <em>next</em> weekend too. But <em>this</em> weekend counts for something. So, get up early in time to get your game face on, because the Tide is playing the kitty cats to win the SEC West! Keeping the <em>polite</em> pre-game spirit we saw from lane kiffin and jimbo last week, “Good luck to you, wildcats.”</p><p>I have to be nice, because the wild cats are Bette Davis’ favorite team, but she knows in the end…the Tide will be victorious, she will be distraught and unable to get out of bed…just like every day of a cat’s life.</p><p><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," height="320" width="240"></p><p>(Yeah…so, I have some animals who need some press time.)&nbsp;</p><p>Back on topic, there are those who are saying Alabama’s continued improvement and even winning out against Georgia in the SEC may not be enough to get past Texas who beat us earlier in the season?! That was before we made all this progress and since that time Texas has lost to a Oklahoma team who has now lost two games in a row. And that being the case, these folks are suggesting we need to hope tennessee beats missouri as well as send positive vibes lsu’s way so these two teams continue to be top tiered wins for us!? While that may be a “change” of behavior for sure, I don’t see anything resembling <em>perfection</em> in that plan. That’s just like flushing a perfectly good cat down the toilet.&nbsp;</p><p><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," height="240" width="320"></p><p>I say NO to flushing cats down the toilet! (I got you, Bette Davis.)&nbsp;</p><p>YES to beating the wildcats!</p><p>NO for wishing the best to our archrivals!&nbsp;</p><p>And YES to trusting in Coach Saban who has gotten us this far!</p><p>RTR and let’s go win the West! Enjoy Week 11!</p><p>&nbsp;Jackie&nbsp;</p>
